ValidationRule.description: This validation rule restrics Refund edit after Approved by Operations for users don't have custom permission Egypt_Refund_Edit_Access.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Approval_Status__c , 'Approved by Operations' ), NOT( $Permission.Egypt_Refund_Edit_Access ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to edit Approved by Operations Refunds.
